title: Cyberwave Quaternion
description: A rotation as a quaternion with named components, listed x, y, z, w as in protobuf geometry.v1.Quaternion. The keys carry the meaning, so key order is irrelevant and the xyzw/wxyz question never arises in JSON; an array is never used. A rotation is expected to have unit length; the schema cannot say so, and writers that care check the norm with cyberwave_geometry.
